title: Efficient verifier for halting runs
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine and let $A,e$ be natural numbers. There is an efficient verifier $M$ with values in $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true},\mathrm{undefined}\}$ such that, for every pair of bit strings $x,r$ with $|r|=A(|x|+1)^e$ and every bit $b$, $M(x,r)=b$ if and only if the run of $N$ on input $x$ under choices $r$ halts with output exactly the one-bit word $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine
The verifier's random-string input has length $A(|x|+1)^e$
The equivalence is required for every pair of bit strings $x,r$ of that length and every bit $b$
